title: Acoustic–seismic detection and classification of military vehicles—developing tools for disarmament and peace-keeping
source_pdf: ABVID Lit Review/pdf-ver/Acoustic–seismic detection and classification of military vehicles—developing tools for disarmament and peace-keeping.pdf
source_markdown: ABVID Lit Review/markdown-ver/Acoustic–seismic detection and classification of military vehicles—developing tools for disarmament and peace-keeping/Acoustic–seismic detection and classification of military vehicles—developing tools for disarmament and peace-keeping.md
classification_task: Author: tracked/wheeled separation and recognition among selected recorded military vehicles from acoustic/seismic signals [P05, §§3.5,4.4]
class_definition: Author: broad tracked/wheeled labels; harmonic classifier uses Leopard 1, Leopard 2, M48, Jaguar, Fuchs, Hermelin, MB1017, Unimog. Wiesel and VW van excluded because reliable harmonic series could not be obtained [P05, Table 2; §§4.3–4.4]
recognition_level: Review: broad categories plus nominal type labels evaluated on the recorded exemplars; no independent-exemplar model recognition established [P05, §§4.4–5]
model_level_evidence: Author: recognizes engine including exhaust configuration, not actual vehicle type; different types with the same engine can be grouped. Independent same-model exemplars: unknown [P05, §5]
dataset: Author: BVP Meppen WTD91 campaign, 12 October–10 November 2000; five tracked and five wheeled test vehicles [P05, §2; Tables 1–2]
public_availability: unknown; archived measurements described, but no public raw-data release/access route established [P05, §2]
acoustic_representation: Author: RMS maxima, spectra/spectrograms; harmonic classifier uses log-transformed relative powers of first 15 harmonics of an estimated engine fundamental [P05, §§3.1–3.4]
classifier_model: Author: optimal straight-line acoustic/seismic category separation; learning vector quantization with 10 codebook vectors per selected vehicle label [P05, §§3.5,4.4]
source_engine_state: controlled/varied: moving and standing runs; engine types documented; RPM inferred from harmonic series. Independent throttle/load measurement: unknown [P05, §§2,4.3,5]
speed: controlled nominal speedometer targets: 40,30,20,15,10,5 km/h, minimum speed and standing; exact speed trajectories unknown [P05, §2]
distance: controlled: known lanes and sensor coordinates; varying range during passes. No independent held-out-distance split established [P05, Table 1; §§2,4.2]
direction: controlled/varied: both travel directions; near-maximum feature selection restricts some observation angles, not explicit angle invariance [P05, §§2,4.2–4.4]
propagation_geometry: controlled: two sensor sites separated by 101.4 m; lane/sensor coordinates and 0.30 m microphone height documented; moving pass geometry [P05, Table 1; §2]
terrain_ground: controlled/varied: concrete lane 0 and sand lanes 1–3; no terrain-randomization distribution established [P05, §2; Table 1, PDF p.4]
weather: measured: meteorological station; wind/rain discussed in background measurements; factorial weather control unknown [P05, §§2,4.1]
background_noise: measured/selected: backgrounds observed; low-audibility passes excluded and some fundamental estimates operator-corrected. Prescribed randomized SNR: unknown [P05, §§4.1,4.3]
microphone_sensor: controlled: B&K 4198 microphones, SM6 three-component geophones, specified filtering/sampling; suspected power-supply acoustic noise discussed [P05, §§2,4.1]
invariance: Author: relative harmonic powers tolerate scalar gain, absolute time shift and uniform frequency scaling; frequency-dependent propagation, angle and RPM-dependent harmonic balance remain [P05, §3.4 and footnote 4; §5]
eval_random_within: yes: 2/3 of feature vectors from every pass used for training, 1/3 for testing; both subsets share passes [P05, §4.4]
eval_heldout_condition: no distinct held-out physical condition established; near-maximum and full-pass variants [P05, §4.4]
eval_heldout_sensor: unknown; independent sensor-held-out recognition not reported [P05, §4.4]
eval_heldout_location: unknown; independent location-held-out recognition not reported [P05, §§2,4.4]
split_details: Author: within-pass feature selection/split and trial-and-error LVQ codebook selection. Review: separate selection-validation set unknown [P05, §4.4]
test_domain: real → real within the same campaign and passes [P05, §4.4]
reported_results: Author: 93.8% category separation with optimized acoustic/seismic boundary; 89% full-pass accuracy over the eight retained labels. Different tasks/protocols; no unseen-session claim [P05, §§4.2,4.4; Table 3, PDF p.20]
author_limitations: Engine/exhaust rather than actual vehicle-type identification; two vehicles lack reliable series; relative powers vary with RPM/angle; further systematic measurements needed [P05, §5]
review_interpretation: Review: within-pass dependence, selection of audible examples and excluded vehicles limit generalization claims; high nominal-type accuracy is not new-exemplar model recognition [P05, §§4.3–4.4]
pdf_verification: Visually checked missing Lane 3 header and Table 3; no values reconstructed from Markdown [P05, PDF pp.4,20]

classification_task: Author: empirical characterization for detection/classification/verification; no new supervised classification benchmark in this paper [P04, §§1,7]
class_definition: Author: named heavy military vehicles and tracked/wheeled comparisons; no fixed output class set for a trained classifier [P04, §2; Tables 1–2]
recognition_level: Review: physical signature evidence; neither an individual-recognition benchmark nor validated model-level recognition [P04, §§5,7]
model_level_evidence: unknown; independent physical-exemplar model-classification evaluation not established [P04, §§2,5,7]
dataset: Author: BVP campaigns at Doksy, Baumholder (two campaigns), Amersfoort, 1989–1992, acoustic and seismic measurements [P04, §2]
public_availability: unknown; open cooperative experiments do not establish public downloadable raw recordings [P04, §2]
acoustic_representation: Author: waveform amplitudes/RMS, FFT spectra and time-frequency harmonics; acoustic/seismic comparisons and array delays [P04, §§3–6]
classifier_model: not applicable: physical analysis and beamforming, no trained recognition classifier evaluated [P04, §§4–7]
source_engine_state: controlled/varied: stationary and moving vehicles, engine/gearing specifications, loaded/unloaded examples; exhaust/intake and track contributions discussed; comprehensive component isolation unknown [P04, §§2,5.1–5.3]
speed: controlled nominal passes including 5,20,40 km/h; additional increments at Amersfoort; measured using light beams in described campaigns [P04, §2; §§4.1,5.1]
distance: controlled/measured geometry: multiple receiver distances; inverse-distance-like fits to pass maxima, not universal instantaneous attenuation [P04, §§2,4.1]
direction: controlled/varied: both travel directions and observation angles; rear/exhaust radiation changes waveform [P04, §§2,3,5.3]
propagation_geometry: controlled arrays and pass trajectories; reflections, diffraction, refraction and multipath discussed; separate causal contributions not fully isolated [P04, §§2,3,6.1]
terrain_ground: controlled/varied: concrete/tarmac/sand sites; deliberate 2 cm bump strongly affects seismic excitation [P04, §§2,6.2]
weather: Author discusses wind/temperature refraction and background; independent weather control/randomization/held-out weather: unknown [P04, §§1.2,4.2]
background_noise: measured/discussed: ambient noise and competing vehicles can mask targets; no randomized controlled-SNR classification trial [P04, §§4.2,5.2]
microphone_sensor: controlled: specified microphones/geophones, arrays, placement, sampling and filters; acoustic and seismic modalities must remain separate [P04, §2; Table 2]
invariance: unknown as a validated classifier property; amplitude/harmonic changes measured rather than made invariant [P04, §§4–7]
eval_random_within: unknown; not established in the described study [P04, §§2–7]
eval_heldout_condition: unknown; not established in the described study [P04, §§2–7]
eval_heldout_sensor: unknown; not established in the described study [P04, §§2–7]
eval_heldout_location: unknown; not established in the described study [P04, §§2–7]
eval_crossdomain: unknown; not established in the described study [P04, §§2–7]
split_details: not applicable: no train/test recognition split [P04, §§2–7]
test_domain: real measurement campaigns; no train → test classifier transfer result [P04, §§2–7]
reported_results: Author: acoustic pass-maxima distance exponents approximately -1.16 to -0.94 in fitted cases; not a recognition accuracy or universal propagation law [P04, §4.1]
author_limitations: Complex mechanisms not fully isolated given time constraints; unexplained spectral lines; multiple sources/paths; further recognition, separation and localization work required [P04, §§5.3,6,7]
review_interpretation: Review: physical mechanisms motivate source/propagation factors, but their relative contribution to a learned synthetic-to-real gap is unknown [P04, §§1.2,5–7]
pdf_verification: Visually checked propagation discussion, micro-units (2 and 4 µm/s, not mm/s) and harmonic figure [P04, PDF pp.5,15,20]

classifier_model: Author: terrain-specific type-1/type-2 fuzzy rules and Bayesian classifier; adaptive parameter learning, Bayesian terrain combination and majority voting [P13, chapter 3, §§3–4]

speed: controlled/varied: approximately constant within run, 5–40 km/h across runs; randomized speed sampling unknown [P13, chapter 3, §2.1]

propagation_geometry: controlled acquisition array; moving trajectories and CPA selection; full calibrated propagation factorization unknown [P13, chapter 3, §§2.1–2.2]

weather: coarse arctic/desert/normal conditions; quantitative weather measurement/randomization unknown [P13, chapter 3, §2.1]
background_noise: CPA selection favors high SNR; noise uncertainty discussed, explicit randomized noise/SNR intervention unknown [P13, chapter 3, §§2.2–2.3]
microphone_sensor: controlled: three channels, sampling about 1025 Hz and per-channel normalization; held-out sensor unknown [P13, chapter 3, §2.2]
invariance: scalar-energy normalization and harmonic indexing; uncertainty modelling, not demonstrated invariance to terrain/RPM/sensors [P13, chapter 3, §§2.2–3]

eval_heldout_sensor: unknown; not established in the described study [P13, chapter 3, §§2–6; printed pp.55–77]
eval_heldout_location: unknown; not established in the described study [P13, chapter 3, §§2–6; printed pp.55–77]

classification_task: Author: five-label acoustic vehicle classification using complementary feature decisions [P12, §6]
class_definition: Author: V1,V2 tracked and V3,V4,V5 wheeled vehicle-type labels; exact make/model names unknown [P12, §6; Table 1]
recognition_level: Review: nominal type/recorded-label recognition; not merely binary tracked/wheeled, but independent model exemplars unknown [P12, §6]

dataset: Author: US Army Research Laboratory, six circle runs per each of five vehicle labels [P12, §6]
public_availability: unknown; ARL access described, no public release established [P12, §6]
acoustic_representation: Author: 1 s Hamming/FFT at 1024 Hz; 351 low-frequency bins, 21 harmonic features and mutual-information-selected key-frequency bins [P12, §§3–4,6]
classifier_model: Author: multiple Gaussian classifier for harmonics, polynomial SVM for key frequencies; concatenation and modified Bayesian decision fusion [P12, §§4–5]
source_engine_state: engine/body periodic sound motivates features; measured RPM/load/throttle unknown [P12, §§3,6–7]
speed: varied between vehicle runs, affecting run duration; authors flag velocity-dependent key-bin stability; controlled/measured exact speeds unknown [P12, §§6–7]
distance: vehicle circles array; exact radius/distance measurement unknown [P12, §6]
propagation_geometry: controlled circular-track/array arrangement; calibrated geometry values unknown [P12, §6]
terrain_ground: road conditions acknowledged as affecting features; experimental ground labels/control unknown [P12, §7]
weather: unknown; not established in the described study [P12, §§3–7 (online 2011; journal issue 2012)]

microphone_sensor: acoustic array recordings sampled at 1024 Hz; microphone make/response unknown [P12, §6]

classification_task: Author: military ground-vehicle recognition from time-domain harmonic amplitudes [P09, §V]
class_definition: Author: nine recorded BVP vehicles: Leopard1, Leopard2, M48, Jaguar, Wiesel, Fuchs, Hermelin, MB1017, Unimog; VW van excluded for insufficient samples [P09, §V, footnote 5]
recognition_level: individual recorded-vehicle recognition; authors explicitly state one physical vehicle per class [P09, §V, footnote 5]
dataset: Author: BVP 2000 Meppen; 365 runs, over 19.5 hours; energy-gated half-second events [P09, §V]
public_availability: unknown; no public raw-data release established [P09, §V]
acoustic_representation: Author: least-squares amplitudes of 50 harmonic components plus event energy and strongest-component frequency (52 features); fitted frequency grid is not necessarily engine fundamental [P09, §§III–IV]
classifier_model: Author: feedforward neural network, 52 inputs, 40 hidden nodes, nine outputs; Rprop, temporal voting [P09, §IV]
source_engine_state: varied operating runs from BVP; explicit RPM/load stratification unknown [P09, §V]
speed: varied BVP speed conditions; no held-out-speed evaluation [P09, §V; Fig.8]
distance: controlled sensor/lane positions, varying pass distance; energy feature retains range effects [P09, §V; Fig.8]
direction: varied travel directions and observation sides [P09, §V; Fig.8]
propagation_geometry: controlled two-station geometry; station transfer changes path and viewpoint together [P09, §V; Fig.8]
terrain_ground: concrete/sand lane conditions documented; no terrain-held-out protocol [P09, §V; Fig.8]
weather: wind/recording conditions described; independent weather control or measurement-based classification analysis unknown [P09, §V]
background_noise: energy/CFAR gate selects events; low-power harmonic signatures are difficult. Prescribed randomized noise unknown [P09, §III-A; §V]
microphone_sensor: controlled BVP recording stations; 20 kHz downsampled to 5 kHz; sensor location held out in one protocol, microphone-model-only intervention unknown [P09, §V]
invariance: Author uses harmonic fitting for compact features. Review: energy and strongest frequency retain state/range information; full RPM/gain invariance not established [P09, §§III–IV,VI]
eval_random_within: yes: random 1/3 events train, 2/3 test, 100 Monte Carlo trials [P09, §V]
eval_heldout_condition: yes: separate-run train/test halves additionally evaluated; physical condition exclusion unknown [P09, §V; Table V]
eval_heldout_sensor: yes: one recording station train, the other test; same passes and changed geometry, not independent sensor model only [P09, §V; Table V]
eval_heldout_location: separate station within one site, not independent recording location [P09, §V]
split_details: three distinct random-event, separate-station and separate-run designs; same nine exemplars across splits [P09, §V]
test_domain: real → real BVP, with different levels of grouping [P09, §V]

author_limitations: One physical exemplar per class; weak harmonics/light vehicles harder; Volkswagen excluded; harmonic approximation and computation tradeoffs [P09, §§V–VI]
review_interpretation: Review: separate-run/station results are stronger than random-event results but still do not establish same-model new-exemplar recognition; class false-alarm statistic is not continuous vehicle-absence false-alarm performance [P09, §V]

classification_task: Author: cross-dataset civilian vehicle/background classification and paired microphone robustness [P01, §2.1]
class_definition: Author: car,truck,motorcycle,bus,background(no vehicle); tram/bicycle excluded from target [P01, §2.1]
recognition_level: broad vehicle categories plus vehicle-absent background, not model identity [P01, §2.1]
dataset: Author: IDMT-Traffic CH12 train8718, CH34 mic test8788; MELAUDIS five-class target14663; derivative counts are paper claims [P01, §2.1; Table1]
public_availability: Author claims archive https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22203993 ; raw IDMT/MELAUDIS public. Current derivative archive accessibility unknown after failed retrieval2026-09-27; primary raw-release metadata independently checked [P01, Data Availability Statement]
acoustic_representation: Author: CNN MFCC40+delta+delta2 at22.05kHz; BEATs/AST internal16kHz Mel-based features and768D embeddings [P01, §§2.2,2.4]
classifier_model: Author: CNN, BEATs iter3+ and AST two-phase head/full fine-tuning; frozen-BEATs256D projection with DANN or ArcFace [P01, §§2.2–2.3]
source_engine_state: naturally varying fleets; measured RPM/load/source configuration unknown [P01, §2.1]
speed: IDMT30/50/70km/h speed-limit areas described; actual per-vehicle speed measurement/control unknown [P01, §2.1]
distance: roadside recordings across sites; per-event measured distance and distance holdout unknown [P01, §2.1]
direction: pass-bys; no direction-controlled experiment established in this paper [P01, §2.1]
propagation_geometry: four German sites versus Australian locations; different geometry bundled with fleet/environment/sensor differences [P01, §§2.1,2.5]
terrain_ground: varied dry/wet road conditions in IDMT; road-surface changes discussed, no factorial surface intervention [P01, §2.1]
weather: dry/wet conditions described; quantitative meteorological measurement/randomization unknown [P01, §2.1]
background_noise: background is an explicit class; naturally varying scenes, no synthetic augmentation/noise randomization applied [P01, §§2.1,2.4]
microphone_sensor: controlled paired IDMT MEMS ICS-43434(CH12) and sE8(CH34); same events cross microphones; mono channel averaging; 246 motorcycle SE files reassigned by mic type despite CH12 name [P01, §§2.1,2.5]
invariance: DANN explicitly targets dataset-domain indistinguishability of projected frozen-BEATs features; ArcFace improves source class separation without target audio; no demonstrated RPM/speed invariance [P01, §2.3]
eval_random_within: 15% stratified training validation; grouping by source event/session unknown [P01, §2.4]
eval_heldout_condition: cross-dataset bundled conditions; no isolated physical-condition holdout [P01, §2.5]
eval_heldout_sensor: yes CH12→CH34, but same vehicle events as training; independent-session sensor robustness not established [P01, §2.5]
eval_heldout_location: cross-country dataset locations differ; no isolated within-dataset leave-location-out result [P01, §§2.1,2.5]
eval_crossdomain: yes IDMT→MELAUDIS; DANN sees unlabelled MELAUDIS during adaptation, unlike source-only baselines/ArcFace [P01, §§2.3–2.5]
split_details: CNN5 training seeds; transformers one training per phase,5 evaluation-subsampling seeds;50/class balanced test; DANN adaptation/evaluation separation unknown [P01, §§2.3–2.5]
test_domain: real → real cross-dataset; DANN labelled source + unlabelled target → target; separate same-event cross-microphone test [P01, §2.5]
reported_results: Author: MELAUDIS macro-F1 CNN0.26,AST0.43,BEATs0.46,DANN0.31,ArcFace0.50; CH34 respectively0.52,0.62,0.75,0.80,0.73 [P01, Table3, PDF p.10]
author_limitations: Extreme imbalance(53 bus),pretraining coverage dependence,one train/test direction,rapid unfreezing overfit,frozen adaptation backbone,only two adaptation methods,clip-only task,no latency/compute evaluation [P01, §4]
review_interpretation: Review: same-event mic versus new-event cross-dataset comparison cannot causally rank environment/source/sensor contributions; frozen-head/full-fine-tuning comparisons need matched controls; iter3+ supervised teacher invalidates clean self-supervised-versus-supervised attribution; DANN is exception to claimed target exclusion [P01, §§2.1–2.5,3.3–3.4; P07 §4.3]
pdf_verification: Visually checked checkpoint/pretraining description, malformed Table3 and per-class figure; authors’ mechanistic explanations kept separate from measured outcomes [P01, PDF pp.6,10–11]
